name: LONGANA
description: Longana is a vibrant and strategic Cuban domino game, often described as 'Domino Solitaire' for teams. Played with a double-nine set (55 tiles), it is famous for its 'arm' (train) mechanic where players build individual sequences extending from a central 'Spinner'. It is a game of blocking and opportunity, where players can force opponents to 'open' their arms, allowing others to dump unwanted tiles on them.

content.text: Longana is a vibrant and strategic Cuban domino game, often described as 'Domino Solitaire' for teams. Played with a double-nine set (55 tiles), it is famous for its 'arm' (train) mechanic where players build individual sequences extending from a central 'Spinner'. It is a game of blocking and opportunity, where players can force opponents to 'open' their arms, allowing others to dump unwanted tiles on them.
A regional evolution of the 'Mexican Train' and 'Matador' families, specifically adapted for the 55-tile double-nine deck in Cuba.
4 players individually (can be played with 2 or 3).
Double-nine domino set and flat surface.
Each player receives 8 tiles (for 4 players) or 10 tiles (for 2-3 players). The rest form the boneyard.
